gaps.explanation: Re-read p7 (printed p10), Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds. Fund columns: Transfers in General 416,325, Street Repair and Maintenance 1,851,585, Debt Service 71,814 (= 2,339,724, all already in detail gross, p7 lines); Transfers out General (50,878), Debt Service (20,992), Special Grants (464,733) (all in detail). The Reclassifications column prints +536,603 on Transfers out and (536,603) on Transfers in, so the Total Governmental Funds column prints Transfers in 1,803,121 and no Transfers out (the JSON statement figures). 2,339,724 - 536,603 = 1,803,121. Detail records the printed fund-column transfers gross; the statement total nets the intra-governmental transfers. Nothing missing, nothing to add or remove.

JSON business-type receipts come from p10 (printed p14), Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (Enterprise Fund column = Total; Internal Service Fund column has only transfers): Charges for services 4,498,095 + Sales taxes 422,501 + Miscellaneous 24,174 (total operating revenues 4,944,770) + Interest and investment revenue 199,933 + Grants 2,024 + Insurance claims reimbursements 211,037 + Employee benefit claim receipts (net of expense) 42,382 = 5,400,146. Detail holds the report's own departmental schedule, pp13-14 (printed pp47-48), Enterprise Fund Accounts - ACCRUAL BASIS combining schedules (Light, Water, Sewer, Sanitation, Others): total operating revenues 4,968,845 (Charges for services 4,522,170) + Interest 199,933 + Grants 2,024 + Employee benefit claims net of premiums 15,286 + Insurance proceeds 211,037 = 5,397,125; every printed department line is already in detail. Gap 3,021 = (4,498,095 - 4,522,170) + (42,382 - 15,286) = -24,075 + 27,096. The two printed totals differ by basis (modified cash vs accrual). Adding the Enterprise Fund column of p10 would double count the department lines, so nothing added.

p10 (printed p14) Enterprise Fund column: total operating expenses 4,843,252 + Debt issuance costs and trustee fees 85,900 + Interest expense 147,292 = 5,076,444 (JSON statement). Accrual-basis departmental schedule p13 (printed p47): total operating expenses 4,814,811, plus p14 (printed p48) interest expense 147,292 and debt issuance costs and trustee fee 85,900 = 5,048,003; all its lines are in detail. Differences printed row by row: Insurance 160,094 vs 154,966 (5,128); Plant repairs, maintenance, and supplies 661,499 vs 638,186 (23,313); 5,128 + 23,313 = 28,441 = gap. Basis difference; nothing added.
